name: THEATRHYTHM FINAL BAR LINE
_note: The 42 PS4 trophies, read from the encrypted save (reader "theatrhythm": AES-128-CBC + raw DEFLATE + MessagePack). The save password is not shipped: put it in sdmc:/switch/TrophyNX/keys/theatrhythm.txt (see tools/theatrhythm/README.md). Scan on close (popups): the live module builds only the values the rules use (~2.3 MB peak instead of ~11 MB). Not tracked: THEATRHYTHM Maestro (platinum: no rule type for "every other"), A Musical Journey Begins (which world is the THEATRHYTHM series is unknown), Overflowing Gold (a filled Critical Chart is not stored as such), Show of Finesse, Unstoppable Force, Summon Tamer and Summon's True Power (per-song / per-attack values, not saved), 999er (current stats are not saved, only growth), Grand Rhythmist and Ultimate Rhythmist (need the list of base-game songs and a per-song test across difficulties). Feats (in-game achievements, ids feat_*): the ones that are not already a trophy. Not tracked: the 29 "Cleared first <series> song" feats and "Played a song from every Series Quest title" (which song belongs to which series is in the game's MusicTable, inside encrypted asset bundles), "Played/Cleared every song", "Filled 10/100 Critical Charts", the 5 "every rarity of ... CollectaCards" feats (card table), the 7 stat feats (current stats are not saved) and the 4 per-song feats.
